title: UnifiedAOEvent
description: Normalized event emitted by the AO supervision sidecar. Every event from any source (ao_api, ao_sse, git, test) is converted to this shape before rules run.

timestamp.description: UTC ISO-8601 time of the event (best-effort: turn-level when activity-level time is unavailable).

task_id.description: AO turn id when known, else null.

worker_id.description: AO session id of the worker, else null.

source.description: Channel that produced the raw event.

activity.description: True if this event counts as worker activity (command, tool call, error, approval, ...). Used by the NO_PROGRESS rule.

progress.description: True if this event counts as any kind of progress (weak or strong). Back-compat boolean.

progress_strength.description: none=not progress; weak=file edit (unproven); strong=test green/commit/gate pass. NO_PROGRESS counts only strong by default.

message.description: Human-readable summary, used for fingerprinting error events.

fingerprint.description: Normalized fingerprint of the message (error events only; null otherwise).

evidence.description: Raw supporting data from the source (paths, diffs, sequences, ...).
